summary: The candidate asks for a little time alone before speaking with the winner.
realLife: While the 1981 New Jersey governor’s race was still unsettled, Thomas Kean told a reporter he had spent the morning after election night walking in the woods and playing with his children. He ultimately won the race.
inGame: needs: a recorded delay for a later callback. The race-lost conversation can represent the choice.
gates: The candidate has deferred the call.

turns.what: The candidate asks everyone else to step outside and stays at the desk.
turns.pulledBy: The candidate wants privacy and needs the returns within reach.
turns.writesBack: The room clears until the candidate calls the manager back.

turns.what: When the candidate comes in from the walk, a revised county figure is waiting beside the phone.
turns.pulledBy: An election official corrected the return while the candidate was away.
turns.writesBack: The manager dates the revised count and asks the candidate to read it before placing a call.
